source.note: All 16 collector checklists checked card by card against the frozen TCDB source snapshot. Beckett confirms base size and hobby configuration; see research notes for odds evidence and source corrections.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Hobby: 5 cards per pack, 20 packs per box. Retail 4-card packs are not a separate VCS product.
decisions.baseStructure: One complete #1-216 Base checklist. #151-216 are SP true RCs; availability flattened within Base to preserve collector completion.
decisions.parallelStructure: Two complete #1-216 Xtra Points checklists; #1-150 SN150 and #151-216 SN25. No split by serial-number tier.
decisions.promotions: Exclude National Embossed, National Embossed Banner Season, Beckett Samples Gold and Silver; these are non-pack promotions.
decisions.redemptions: Draft Picks Autographs models the 25 fulfilled redemption cards, not a claim that signed cards were physically inserted.
decisions.unsignedCards: Sophomore Signatures SS26 Marvin Minnis, SS30 Nate Clements and SS39 Travis Henry are unsigned SN100 cards. Other AU and SP notes preserved per card.
decisions.odds: Only Draft Picks, Inside the Numbers and League Leader Tandems use documented 1:18. All other hit odds remain null pending evidence; print runs are never converted into invented pack ratios.
decisions.sourceCorrections: Connections C-7 team corrected to Carolina Panthers. Materials LL16 team order corrected to match Troy Brown / Keyshawn Johnson. Other TCDB team labels retained, including Colts franchise labeling for Raymond Berry.
decisions.releaseSafety: Unreleased draft; pack odds, pricing and images must be reviewed before release.
